## Problem or Use Case
Describe the problem you're trying to solve, or the use case this feature would enable.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you'd like this to work.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered other approaches? Why is this one preferred?

## Specification Impact
Which parts of NEOS would this affect?
- [ ] Core field engine (`core/`)
- [ ] Commands (`commands/`)
- [ ] Autonomy system (`autonomy/`)
- [ ] Visualization (`visualization/`)
- [ ] Interfaces (`interfaces/`)
- [ ] Persistence (`persistence/`)
- [ ] Documentation / examples

## Additional Context
Any diagrams, equations, references, or related prior art.
